description_en: Updates the metadata of an entity. You can modify the entity name, but not the entity type
description_zh: 实体meta信息修改，仅支持修改实体名称；实体类型不支持修改
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot update-ds-entity --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --instance-id chatbot-cn-yjzbyrEvqd --entity-id 123 --entity-name '实体名称' --entity-type synonyms --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDSEntity

parameters.help_en: The business space key. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the default business space. You can get this key from the business management page of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en: The new name for the entity. The name can contain only Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (\_)
parameters.help_zh: 实体名称，仅支持中文、大小写字母、数字、下划线
parameters.name: entity_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the entity. This parameter cannot be modified. Valid values: `synonyms` and `regex`
parameters.name: entity_type
